children: Overview
U.S. grocery retailer's Q2 sales slightly beat analyst expectations, adjusted EPS rose 5% and beat
Identical sales without fuel grew 0.2% amid regulatory headwinds
Company repurchased $1 bln in shares during the quarter
Outlook
Kroger cuts 2026 identical sales without fuel growth forecast to 0.2%-0.8% from 1.0%-2.0%
Company maintains 2026 adjusted EPS guidance at $5.10-$5.30
Kroger reaffirms 2026 adjusted FIFO operating profit guidance at $5.0-$5.2 bln
Result Drivers
REGULATORY HEADWINDS - Co said identical sales growth was limited by an approximately 140 basis point unfavorable impact from the Inflation Reduction Act
ECOMMERCE AND MEDIA PROFITABILITY - Improvement in eCommerce and Kroger Precision Marketing profitability contributed to gross margin and profit growth
COST SAVINGS AND PHARMACY/FUEL PERFORMANCE - Adjusted EPS growth was driven by cost savings, strong pharmacy and fuel performance, and improved eCommerce profitability, per CFO David Kennerley
